newsitem.title: USA: Economists divided on what Fed will do Friday.
newsitem.headline: Economists divided on what Fed will do Friday.

text.p: Economists were divided about whether the Federal Reserve would intervene in the money markets on Friday.

Some thought the Fed would remain out of the banking system, but all acknowledged the Fed still had a large add need due to large tax-season Treasury balances. That left room for the Fed to intervene by adding reserves via a round of weekend system repurchase agreements, economists said.
The Fed executed dual operations on Wednesday and on Thursday to address its seasonal add need and economists were not sure if the adds were sufficient to carry the Fed over until Monday.
Federal funds were quoted at 5.44 percent, slightly below the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/2 percent.
